title: Stained Glass
description: Recompose a live source as a leaded stained-glass window. A slowly drifting Voronoi mosaic cuts the frame into glass panes; each pane takes a single saturated colour sampled from the source under it, lit with a soft glassy sheen and a diagonal light streak, and the panes are separated by dark leaded came lines. Pane size, leading width, glass saturation, sheen, drift and pane irregularity are live. A filter: it re-glazes whatever feeds it (camera, a clip, the demo or the layers below), and the mic can lift the sheen.
